summary: Direct Digital Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Thirteenth Amendment to its existing Term Loan Facility. The borrower, DDH LLC, obtained a $695,000 term loan from Lafayette Square USA, Inc. with a maturity of October 12, 2026, funding a $15,000 interest reserve and general corporate purposes. Interest matches existing term loans, with weekly installments escalating to $100,000 and a final $175,000 payment at maturity. The amendment confirms waiver deadlines from August 18, 2026, and adds a cash flow variance financial covenant. After the amendment, $15.5 million aggregate principal remains outstanding. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
